integrity: All equilibrium and Routh–Hurwitz sign claims in the finding are reconstructed with exact rational arithmetic by the bundled standard-library verifier. Literature comparisons distinguish this explicit witness from prior generic wave criteria and from numerical limit-cycle observations in related models.
scientific_limitations: The witness changes the IL-2 saturation, clearance, and relative diffusion parameters well outside the calibrated values in the motivating study; it establishes only local linear finite-wavenumber oscillatory instability, not nonlinear wave persistence or clinical relevance.
title: An explicit finite-wavenumber wave instability in an IL-2 tumour–immune reaction–diffusion model
